pool: Saved Top12 seeds first, followed by their same-source immediate next/previous chunks, deduplicated by ID. One hop only, at most 36 chunks. No gold, domain filters or labels used to expand or rank.
ranking: Use configured LLM as a listwise relevance reranking prototype, JSON exact-permutation contract, temperature=0, max_tokens=1024. Invalid order or provider exception falls back to input pool order with recorded reason. This is not a dedicated cross-encoder model.
generation: Same application generate method/model; rotate four-condition execution order by question. Plain prompt unchanged; boundary condition adds explicit per-chunk delimiters/source positions and boundary/task-focus instructions. Whole chunk bodies unchanged. No response reuse or repeated trials.
scope: Pool and base-budget evidence coverage for all 128 dev questions, no new embeddings. Nine fixed diagnostic questions receive nine rerank calls and 36 generation calls. Do not infer whole-dev reranker accuracy or causal stability from this pilot.
decision: Separate pool coverage, retained-context coverage, answer completeness, source attribution, task focus, and reranking token/time overhead. No promotion to production or held-out test access from this pilot.
